question: Should 0.38.4 be cut from this combined branch now, making it the authoritative landing path over https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but freezing the changelog date and package version commits the repository to a specific release cut and sequencing choice.

options.title: Use this release branch
options.body: Land the combined fix and release metadata for 0.38.4, then close the narrower overlapping PR.

options.title: Land the fix separately
options.body: Merge the narrow fix first and recreate a release-only version bump when 0.38.4 is authorized.

options.title: Delay the release
options.body: Keep the branches open and refresh the release metadata when the release window is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Use this release branch
recommendation.body: Land the combined fix and release metadata for 0.38.4, then close the narrower overlapping PR.
